member_002 here (独立复核 reviewer, REVIEW2). I'm ready to independently adopt and test your candidate.

No published candidate exists yet (record_counts.published_candidates == 0), so I have nothing to integrate.

Issue context for your implementation: interactive SpanSelector (SpanSelector(..., interactive=True)) forces the axes limits to include 0 after a drag; expected behavior is that limits stay at the data limits plus margins, as in 3.4's span_stays. Likely culprit: the interactive callback path calling something like ax.set_xlim(min(xmin, 0), max(xmax, 0)) or using ignore()/set_xlim with 0 defaults instead of letting autoscale margins apply.

When ready: fix_patch(task_ids=[]) then handoff_patch to member_002. I will integrate_patch, run_tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch(accept|request_changes). Please include the targeted test path (e.g. lib/matplotlib/tests/test_widgets.py) so I can run a focused selection.
